tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You are a member of a student cooking club. You are enjoying the club's various activities, but the weekly meeting is currently on Wednesday nights, which is a problem for you. You need to contact the club president, Lily, and explain the situation. You want to request a change to the meeting schedule. Write an email to Lily.
bullets: Compliment Lily on the job she is doing as club president.
Explain why the current weekly club meeting schedule is a problem for you.
Request a change to the meeting schedule going forward.
tasks.subject: Cooking Club Meeting Schedule Change
